request.query: cancel a positive square from a strict inequality and normalize division in an ordered semifield

items.name: strictMono_div_right_of_pos
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Semifield α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [PosMulReflectLT α] {a : α},
  0 < a → StrictMono fun x => x / a

items.name: Mathlib.Tactic.LinearCombination.div_lt_const
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {b c : α} [inst : Semifield α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α],
  b < c → ∀ {a : α}, 0 < a → b / a < c / a

items.name: OrderedSMul.lt_of_smul_lt_smul_of_pos
Mathlib.Tactic.LinearCombination.div_le_const
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {b c : α} [inst : Semifield α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α],
  b ≤ c → ∀ {a : α}, 0 ≤ a → b / a ≤ c / a

items.name: lt_of_mul_self_lt_mul_self₀
items.type:
∀ {M₀ : Type u_2} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] [inst_1 : LinearOrder M₀] [PosMulStrictMono M₀] {a b : M₀} [MulPosMono M₀],
  0 ≤ b → a * a < b * b → a < b
